title: Tue 29 Sep 2026: Yields hit cycle highs, Hormuz oil shock, FCA CFD crackdown, Apollo gates again
summary: US 10-year above 5.25% and gilts near two-decade highs; Brent at $107 after the US rejects Iran's Hormuz plan; BoE's 6-3 hold and November hike pricing; Lagarde on measured hikes before Friday's flash HICP. Regulation: FCA CFD crackdown, FOS changes from 1 October, Form PF delayed to July 2027, SEC pay-to-play rescission, frontier AI and operational resilience. Funds: Apollo Debt Solutions caps redemptions, AllianceBernstein names Onur Erzan CEO, active ETF hires and launches. Plus three COO action points.
